candidate.title: AGO-CLIP
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina AGO-CLIP schematic, resolved by its named Grosswendt et al. reference as the ligation-enhanced C. elegans ALG-1 iPAR-CLIP implementation. It depicts a single photolabeling-to-cDNA route with exogenous T4 RNA ligase, not all AGO-CLIP implementations. iPAR-CLIP is the implementation named by the primary paper, not a separately depicted alternative; CLASH, miR-CLIP, AGO-PAR-CLIP applications and the primary paper’s no-added-ligase route are outside the depicted workflow. IP/PNK end preparation is retained only as the source-supported interface necessary to explain AGO selection and the depicted ligation.
